title: Lovable raises $400 million as its valuation doubles to $13.3 billion
excerpt: Lovable raised $400 million at a $13.3 billion valuation after its ARR nearly tripled in eight months.
content_html:
Lovable doubles its valuation to $13.3 billion as investors place another big bet on AI coding

By Thibault Spirlet

You're currently following this author! Want to unfollow? Unsubscribe via the link in your email.

Lovable is the latest startup to cash in on investor enthusiasm for AI coding, raising $400 million at a $13.3 billion valuation.

Menlo Ventures led the round alongside the EQT-managed Scaleup Europe Fund, which more than doubled Stockholm-based Lovable's valuation in seven months.

Anton Osika, the CEO and cofounder of Lovable, wrote in a Wednesday LinkedIn post that business leaders are using its software to "spin up new product lines," while workers are using it to "build tools that fit their exact needs."

Lovable's raise is the latest big deal in the AI coding space, which has become one of the first major commercial use cases for artificial intelligence. SpaceX agreed in June to buy Cursor for $60 billion, while app-building platform Emergent raised $130 million at a $1.5 billion valuation in July.

Lovable previously raised $330 million at a $6.6 billion valuation in December. It disclosed in March that it had reached $400 million in annual recurring revenue, up from $300 million a month earlier and $200 million at the end of 2025. Osika said its ARR has nearly tripled since December.

In a blog post on Wednesday, Lovable, which helps users build software through natural-language prompts, said more than 60 million projects have been created on its platform since its launch in November 2024.

Osika said the company will use the funding to turn Lovable into a platform for running, rather than simply building, a business.

"The world is full of ambitious people with deep knowledge of problems worth solving. Very few of them have historically had the power to act on them," Osika wrote. "Our ambition is to give people that power, and then help them achieve more than they thought possible."

The funding places Lovable among Europe's most valuable private AI companies.

It's now just below French AI model-maker Mistral's roughly $14 billion valuation, but ahead of AI coding rival Replit, which was valued at $9 billion in March.

The gap between Europe's best-funded AI startups and the biggest US model makers, however, remains vast. Anthropic was recently valued at $1.2 trillion on secondary markets, while OpenAI was valued at about $933 billion, according to Caplight data reported by Business Insider.

Those figures reflect private-share trades rather than priced funding rounds.

随着投资者在人工智能编码上再次下注，Lovable 的估值翻了一番，达到 133 亿美元

作者：Thibault Spirlet 您目前正在关注该作者！ 想要取消关注吗？ 通过电子邮件中的链接取消订阅。

Lovable 是最新一家利用投资者对人工智能编码热情获利的初创公司，以 133 亿美元的估值筹集了 4 亿美元资金。

Menlo Ventures 与 EQT 管理的 Scaleup Europe Fund 一起领投此轮融资，该基金在 7 个月内使总部位于斯德哥尔摩的 Lovable 估值翻了一番多。

Lovable 的首席执行官兼联合创始人安东·奥西卡 (Anton Osika) 在周三的 LinkedIn 帖子中写道，企业领导者正在使用其软件来“启动新产品线”，而员工则使用它来“构建适合他们确切需求的工具”。

Lovable 的融资是人工智能编码领域的最新重大交易，该领域已成为人工智能的首批主要商业用例之一。 SpaceX 在 6 月份同意以 600 亿美元收购 Cursor，而应用程序构建平台 Emergent 在 7 月份以 15 亿美元的估值筹集了 1.3 亿美元。

Lovable 此前于 12 月筹集了 3.3 亿美元，估值为 66 亿美元。 该公司在 3 月份披露，其年度经常性收入已达到 4 亿美元，高于一个月前的 3 亿美元和 2025 年底的 2 亿美元。 Osika 表示，自去年 12 月以来，其 ARR 几乎增加了两倍。

Lovable 在周三的一篇博文中表示，自 2024 年 11 月推出以来，已在其平台上创建了超过 6000 万个项目。Lovable 是一家帮助用户通过自然语言提示构建软件的公司。

Osika 表示，该公司将利用这笔资金将 Lovable 打造成一个运营平台，而不仅仅是建立业务。

“世界上充满了雄心勃勃的人，他们对值得解决的问题有着深入的了解。 历史上很少有人有能力对它们采取行动，”奥西卡写道。 “我们的目标是赋予人们这种力量，然后帮助他们取得比他们想象的更多的成就。”

此次融资使 Lovable 跻身欧洲最有价值的私营人工智能公司之列。

目前，该公司的估值略低于法国人工智能模型制造商 Mistral 约 140 亿美元的估值，但领先于人工智能编码竞争对手 Replit，后者 3 月份的估值为 90 亿美元。

然而，欧洲资金最充足的人工智能初创公司与美国最大的模型制造商之间的差距仍然巨大。 据 Business Insider 报道的 Caplight 数据显示，Anthropic 最近在二级市场的估值为 1.2 万亿美元，而 OpenAI 的估值约为 9330 亿美元。

这些数字反映的是私募股权交易，而不是定价融资轮次。
